who.title: Who we're looking for
who.text: Are you a member of a student group at TU Dresden? Then we need you.

why.title: Why we need you
why.text: We want to check whether our quiz would actually match you to your group. To do this, you answer 20 questions as if you were a first-year student looking for a group. This lets us measure which questions work and which ones need to go.

data.title: What happens with the data
data.text: Completely anonymous. No account. No personal data. We only store your answers and which group you specified.

reward.title: What you get
reward.text: At the end we show you which of the ~80 student groups best match your answers — and whether your own group is among them.

quiz.comingSoonText: The quiz is being prepared. Check back soon!

step0.solution: A quiz that finds which student groups fit you in 3 minutes — like a political voter guide, but for campus life.
step0.scaleTitle: The same problem — everywhere in Germany
step0.openSource: FOMO is open source — any university can deploy it.

step1.title: How the algorithm works
step1.weightNeutral: 0% — Neutral doesn't count. The question is ignored.
step1.weightPositive: {pct}% — The stronger your opinion, the more influence.
step1.step2Body: How similar is your answer to the group profile? The stronger your opinion, the more the question counts.
step1.step3Body: All {count} questions summed → groups sorted by match.
step1.important: Each student group has a binary profile of 17 attributes (e.g. hands-on, international, competition). The algorithm runs entirely in the browser — no user data is stored. Privacy-by-design.
step1.hint: → In the next step you'll see two real personas and their results

step7.title: The pilot study
step7.subtitle: Before FOMO goes live, we test which quiz layout has the highest completion rate. Four variants are tested with real students.

classic.name: Classic
classic.desc: One question per screen, 3 large buttons. Proven voter-guide principle. Maximum focus.

swipe.name: Swipe
swipe.desc: Tinder-style cards. Swipe left = No, right = Yes, up = Neutral. For mobile-native users.

scroll.name: Scroll
scroll.desc: All questions visible at once, grouped by topic. For users who want an overview first.

chat.name: Chat
chat.desc: WhatsApp-style dialogue. FOMO asks questions, you answer. Most personal experience.

step7.measure1Desc: Which of the 60 questions have the highest predictive power?
step7.measure2Desc: Which layout gets users to the end?

step8.tech: Next.js 15, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Auth.js. Deployed via Docker Compose — runs on the university server without external dependencies. Open Source (AGPL-3.0).
